messages.text: Did my first 16 miler before sunrise today. Legs feel like concrete but I'm weirdly happy. Anyone else training for a fall marathon?
Yes! Signed up for Chicago in October. I'm on week 11 of an 18 week plan, longest run so far is 14.
16 on a Wednesday morning? Respect. I'm doing the NYC marathon in November, third time running it. Still haven't figured out fueling.
Wait, that's a Wednesday? No, that was Sunday's run, I'm just still sore. Brain is mush. But NYC is the dream race, how's the lottery treating you?
Got in through the charity route this time, so I'm fundraising on top of training. Lottery odds are brutal.
Gel question for the group: do you take one every 45 min or by feel? Last long run I bonked at mile 12 and it was ugly.
Every 40 min, starting at mile 5, no matter what. Waiting until you feel it is too late. Also sip water with the gel, not just before.
Same, I do 45 but I switched to chews because gels wrecked my stomach. Try them in training, never on race day for the first time.
Okay, 40 min on the clock this weekend. Setting a watch alarm so I stop forgetting.
Also, any recs for early morning routes near the Hudson? I'm tired of the same loop and the bike path gets crowded after 7.
Riverside Park up to the GW Bridge and back is nice and quieter before 6:30. Water fountains are spotty though, carry a bottle.
Or Central Park reservoir loops if you want soft surface. Not great for pace work but kind to the knees.
Thanks both! Maybe we do a group long run one Saturday before taper. I'll buy coffee after.
